req.title: PUT rejects payload ID mismatch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 400 error when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body. This ensures data consistency and prevents ambiguous updates. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct behavior when IDs match, a negative case to test the mismatch scenario, and a boundary case to check behavior at the edge of valid input.

tests.name: test_put_player_id_match
preconditions: Player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/10 with matching squad_number in the body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    '/players/squadnumber/10',
    json={
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
)
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_put_player_id_mismatch
preconditions: Player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/10 with non-matching squad_number in the body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    '/players/squadnumber/10',
    json={
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 11,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
)
assert response.status_code == 400
